_comment: The five-minute mutation run. `npm run test:mutation:fast`.
Same mutants as stryker.config.json and a smaller test surface: api, shared and ui, but not
web. vitest.mutation.config.ts argues for that and measures what it costs — 77.21% here
against 84.39% for the full run, with the whole gap in the two files that are mostly labels
and therefore only readable by a screen.
It is for the loop, not the gate: five minutes is short enough to run after changing a
guard, and eighty-one is not. `break` is 75 rather than 82 because it is measuring less;
the number it is under is its own first clean run, the same way every other threshold in
this repository was set. CI runs the full one.
